tokens.name: ground-hi
tokens.usage: Top of the panel gradient (page background).

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Panel at mid height: flat fills that imitate the background.

tokens.name: ground-shade
tokens.usage: Bottom of the panel gradient. ink, signal-ink and ink-muted on top.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Top rim (in shadow) of the ring of each recess and of the LED collar.

tokens.name: frame-hi
tokens.usage: Bottom rim (lit) of the ring of each recess and of the LED collar.

tokens.name: hollow
tokens.usage: Floor of the recess of buttons and of the key bank.

tokens.name: hollow-dark
tokens.usage: Floor of the recess of the orange button.

tokens.name: hollow-deep
tokens.usage: Floor of the recess of the rocker.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Bottom, lit part of the concave face of buttons.

tokens.name: cream-shade
tokens.usage: Mid tone of the face of buttons.

tokens.name: cream-deep
tokens.usage: Top part, in shadow, of the concave face.

tokens.name: key
tokens.usage: Square base of the keys.

tokens.name: key-face
tokens.usage: Mid tone of the dish of the keys.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Black lever, knob indicator dot and off LED (the last one is not in the reference).

tokens.name: graphite-hi
tokens.usage: Highlight of the graphite cylinder.

tokens.name: alu
tokens.usage: Cap of the knurled knob.

tokens.name: alu-shade
tokens.usage: Base of the knurled knob, between the teeth.

tokens.name: alu-edge
tokens.usage: Outer stroke of the knob cap.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Printed labels and text on the panel and the cream (≥10:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Long secondary text; not in the reference (≥5.2:1 on ground-shade).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Printed marks, pointer and on LED. ink on top (5.2:1).

tokens.name: signal-hi
tokens.usage: Upper, lit part of the orange of rocker and button.

tokens.name: signal-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed face of the rocker; white text on top (6:1). Inner shadow of the on LED.

tokens.name: signal-glow
tokens.usage: Pink highlight on the rims of the rocker.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Labels at the ends of a scale ('uv', 'ir') (≥5.6:1).

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Orange dot of the chosen key.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Mid tone of the green main-function button.

tokens.name: olive-deep
tokens.usage: Shadowed part of the green button.

tokens.name: olive-hi
tokens.usage: Lit part of the green button.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring; ≥10:1 on the panel.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Name of the appliance or the screen.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Title of a group of controls.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: turn the knob until the needle stops.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Label under a control, printed with emboss.

styles.name: scale
styles.usage: Scale numbers and marks. The reference uses 8px; 11px is the legible minimum.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Keys to their labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: LED, control and label inside ap-ctl.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between controls in a row.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups of controls.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Recesses, keys and rocker: nearly square corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Blocks and panels.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Buttons, knobs and LED.

shadow.note: Values from the layer effects of the reference. Global light at 30° (top right): 1px offsets land on -0.87px 0.5px. The long shadows under buttons, knobs and levers are painted and fall straight down; each control brings its own in bundle.css.

tokens.name: emboss
tokens.usage: Labels, printed marks, pointer and LED: 1px white highlight at 30°.

tokens.name: hole
tokens.usage: Inside of each recess (inner shadow of size 14).

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed key.

tokens.name: handle
tokens.usage: Shadow of the thumb of the flat lever (2px at 30°).

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Shallow fields and windows; not in the reference.
